notes:
Tasks: swipe a task to act on it. Right to accept, complete or approve; left to decline, ask for more time or send it back. Each swipe asks for a short remark.

A bell on each task sends a reminder. Whoever set the task can remind the person doing it, and while it is in review the person doing it can remind them to review. One reminder every 30 minutes.

A task can be edited until it is accepted, and every change is kept in its Edit history. Both sides are told automatically when a task becomes overdue.

New Recurring tab: set up a daily, alternate-day, weekly, monthly (including "the first Monday") or yearly task once, and each one arrives in Tasks on its own. Daily ones only need Done; monthly ones arrive 2 days early. Reminders can repeat every few hours, or daily, weekly or monthly at a set time, until the task is done. Each schedule shows who set it.

Employee Cashbook: Reimburse, Advance and Approval tabs with pending counts, and smaller figures at the top. Recording an expense no longer sends a notification; reimbursements and advances still do.

Home: today's celebrations are no longer repeated under Upcoming.

CEO and MD: Departments, Org Masters, Onboarding, Performance, Appraisals and Logo & Signatures are no longer in the menu.
